top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises targeted protein degradation as one induced-proximity principle: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated heterobifunctional degraders, and Handa identified cereblon, which explains the thalidomide-class glues already in clinical use. The mechanism is supported by ternary-complex structures and degradation kinetics, it changes what chemists and clinicians can do with formerly undruggable targets, and the three-name attribution follows traceable discovery steps. P003 keeps the same degrader concept but narrows it to Crews and Deshaies and leaves out the glue mechanism, and adds base editing, which follows the 2020 CRISPR prize closely and rests on classical deamination chemistry, so it ranks second. Perovskites follow on maturity but with contested attribution, then phase separation, where in vivo relevance is still debated.
